scripts.build: pnpm --filter @ultrafuzz/config build && pnpm --filter @ultrafuzz/security build && pnpm --filter @ultrafuzz/topology build && pnpm --filter @ultrafuzz/prompts build && pnpm --filter @ultrafuzz/artifacts build && pnpm --filter @ultrafuzz/references build && tsc -p tsconfig.json && cp ../../.ultrafuzz/topology.yml dist/topology.yml
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @ultrafuzz/runtime build && rm -rf dist-test && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/run-tests.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @ultrafuzz/config build && pnpm --filter @ultrafuzz/security build && pnpm --filter @ultrafuzz/topology build && pnpm --filter @ultrafuzz/prompts build && pnpm --filter @ultrafuzz/artifacts build && pnpm --filter @ultrafuzz/references build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit --pretty false
